title: Notice regarding non-availability of Hon'ble Ms. Justice Gita Gopi on 03.11.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 03/11/2026
It is hereby notified that on 03.11.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 03/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 03.11.2026;
1. Hon’ble Ms. Justice Gita Gopi would not be available for
Judicial as well as Administrative work.
2. Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice M.R.Mengdey)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Gita Gopi.)
By Order of Hon’ble The Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
